scope: Fix all four findings from the updated editor review; preserve concurrent racing/loading/phone preparation and canonical behavior

fixes.EDR01: A verified durable WIP can take the unchanged fast path only when no queued or active write targets that draft. The desired final revision coalesces stale queued writes and follows active writes. Editor exit drains receipts before its Save/Discard decision, so a failed final revision remains retryable instead of being silently dismissed.
fixes.EDR02: Populate passes its cancellation callback into TrackCompiler, propagates it through road/paint/distance-field preparation and releases retained callbacks on early and normal exits. Obsolete compilation stops cooperatively; completed population geometry remains unchanged.
fixes.EDR03: Background scans read each lifecycle once and retain only caption/ready/retry/conflict fields alongside the document summary. Detail redraw/search/resize restores no full document and performs no workflow reads. Lifecycle/library/scope changes invalidate actions immediately and refresh the fenced summary. Retry/Fork read the full current document only when clicked; existing Edit/Test/Publish actions retain their full-load path.
fixes.EDR04: Baked props explicitly select retained pre-upload CPU arrays before evaluating any mesh fallback. The fallback runs only for meshes lacking retained data; original attributes and final rendered output remain exact.

measurement_notes: New paired UI and mesh-access measurements ran separately for each renderer. Other Godot workloads existed on the shared host. Existing broader regressions ran concurrently; their incidental timings are not a performance comparison.
Mesh timing isolates 96 accesses to an actual 12863-vertex container resource; it is not a full-placement or phone FPS claim.

Cancellation uses an ordered token that expires within the actual compiler, proving callback propagation without timing-dependent acceptance. Earlier review timed an expiration at 1ms; those measurements are related but not a strictly paired latency sample.
